description: Set up a local LlamaIndex agent-workflow server (llama-agents) on the remote: ensure Ollama, create a venv, write a sample workflow app driven by local Ollama, and serve it on 127.0.0.1:8080. Run workflows from the phone; long ones can ping you via ntfy on completion.

steps.description: Make sure the AI Chat plugin's Ollama is running on 127.0.0.1:11434 (start it if installed). Install the AI Chat plugin first if this reports it missing.
steps.run: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; if command -v ollama >/dev/null 2>&1; then export OLLAMA_HOST=127.0.0.1:11434; nohup ollama serve >/tmp/ollama.log 2>&1 & for i in $(seq 1 20); do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/version >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; sleep 1; done; fi; echo "Ollama not reachable on 127.0.0.1:11434 — install/run the AI Chat plugin first (it sets up Ollama with no root)."

steps.description: Pull the chat model with Ollama (skipped if present).
steps.run: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; command -v ollama >/dev/null 2>&1 && ollama pull llama3.1 || echo "Ollama CLI not found — install the AI Chat plugin first."

steps.description: Create a venv and install llama-agents-server + workflows + Ollama (no root).
steps.run: set -e; mkdir -p "$HOME/.mobilessh/llamaagents"; python3 -m venv "$HOME/.mobilessh/llamaagents/venv"; "$HOME/.mobilessh/llamaagents/venv/bin/pip" install -U pip; "$HOME/.mobilessh/llamaagents/venv/bin/pip" install llama-index-workflows llama-agents-server llama-agents-client llama-index-llms-ollama

steps.description: Write the agent-workflow app (app.py): a sample workflow on local Ollama, plus a small /ask + /ask/{id} API on the WorkflowServer for the phone UI.
steps.run:
mkdir -p "$HOME/.mobilessh/llamaagents"; cat > "$HOME/.mobilessh/llamaagents/app.py" <<'PYEOF'
import asyncio, uuid
from workflows import Workflow, step
from workflows.events import StartEvent, StopEvent
from llama_index.llms.ollama import Ollama
from llama_agents.server import WorkflowServer
from starlette.requests import Request
from starlette.responses import JSONResponse

OLLAMA = "http://127.0.0.1:11434"
llm = Ollama(model="llama3.1", base_url=OLLAMA, request_timeout=180.0)


class Ask(Workflow):
    @step
    async def run_step(self, ev: StartEvent) -> StopEvent:
        prompt = getattr(ev, "prompt", None) or "Say hello."
        result = await llm.acomplete(prompt)
        return StopEvent(result=str(result))


wf = Ask(timeout=600)
server = WorkflowServer()
server.add_workflow("ask", wf)

# A tiny, stable API the phone UI drives (avoids the raw event-envelope protocol).
JOBS = {}


async def _run_job(job_id, prompt):
    try:
        result = await wf.run(prompt=prompt)
        JOBS[job_id] = {"status": "done", "result": str(result)}
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        JOBS[job_id] = {"status": "error", "result": str(e)}


async def ask(request: Request):
    try:
        body = await request.json()
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
        body = {}
    prompt = (body or {}).get("prompt") or "Say hello."
    job_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
    JOBS[job_id] = {"status": "running", "result": None}
    asyncio.create_task(_run_job(job_id, prompt))
    return JSONResponse({"id": job_id})


async def ask_status(request: Request):
    job_id = request.path_params["id"]
    return JSONResponse(JOBS.get(job_id, {"status": "unknown", "result": None}))


server.app.add_route("/ask", ask, methods=["POST"])
server.app.add_route("/ask/{id}", ask_status, methods=["GET"])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(server.serve(host="127.0.0.1", port=8080))
PYEOF

steps.description: Start the agent server bound to loopback 127.0.0.1:8080 and wait for /health.
steps.run: curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8080/health >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; cd "$HOME/.mobilessh/llamaagents"; export WORKFLOWS_PY_SERVER_HOST=127.0.0.1 WORKFLOWS_PY_SERVER_PORT=8080; nohup "$HOME/.mobilessh/llamaagents/venv/bin/python" app.py >/tmp/llamaagents.log 2>&1 & for i in $(seq 1 60); do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8080/health >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; sleep 1; done; echo "Agent server did not become ready; see /tmp/llamaagents.log (the workflows/llama-agents import paths may need adjusting for the installed version)." >&2; tail -n 20 /tmp/llamaagents.log >&2 || true; exit 1

uninstall.description: Remove the agent venv and app.
